about_the_game:
Welcome to Pretty Peculiar Lovers! This visual novel dating sim will take you for a ride you may not be ready for.

You play as Aidan, a new student at your high school. Aidan is uncertain and shy, but he will soon meet the four romance candidates, Kai, Ruby, Julian, and Lucy. They may seem warm and welcoming at first, but each of them may be hiding their own secrets...

Discover your many options in this narrative driven dating sim, where your decisions impact the characters and outcome of the game. Explore and uncover the unhinged nature of these memorable and, questionably beloved, characters.

content_descriptors.notes: The characters may occasionally swear, and there are subtle hints toward a sexual relationship between characters. Nothing is ever shown or depicted.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10+
  • Processor: 2 Ghz
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: 128MB, OpenGL 3+
  • Storage: 300 MB available space

short_description: Pretty Peculiar Lovers is a visual novel dating sim with a compelling twist, where your decisions impact which romance candidate you engage with, and what secrets you may uncover about them. Come prepared, these seemingly kind and welcoming individuals may not be how they appear.
